name: Sal-in Jeotaeg-ui Budapest
source:
Doyle, lost in the mountains during a blizzard, finds a group of fellow hikers. The stranded hikers are offered food and shelter at a grand estate. But when they try to leave, one of them turns up dead.

Who is the killer?
No matter who you think it is, you're in for a surprise!

* Enough with predictable mysteries!

Try the comic murder mystery "Murders on Budapest: Comic murder adventure story game" and choose your own mystery. Whoever you think the killer is, you're in for a surprise.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.murder.budapest.novel.adventure.story.games]English Google Play[/url]]
translation:
多伊尔在暴风雪中迷失在山中，他找到了一群徒步旅行者。被困的徒步旅行者在一座宏伟的庄园里获得了食物和住所。但当他们试图离开时，其中一人却死了。

凶手是谁？
不管你认为是谁，你都会感到惊讶！

* 可预见的谜团已经够了！

尝试漫画谋杀之谜“布达佩斯谋杀案：漫画谋杀冒险故事游戏”并选择你自己的谜团。无论你认为凶手是谁，你都会大吃一惊。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.murder.budapest.novel.adventure.story.games]English Google Play[/url]]
